We're preparing the network for bushfire season

As part of our ongoing commitment to safety and reliability, our crews are undertaking vegetation management works near powerlines to help reduce bushfire risk and strengthen network resilience. Temporary power outages may be required to carry out this work safely, and affected customers will be notified in advance wherever possible.

Our crews are working near live power lines, which can be dangerous.
 
To keep our team and the community safe, we may need to temporarily interrupt your power supply while we carry out essential maintenance and repairs.
 
Thanks for your understanding as we work to keep your energy services safe and reliable.
 
We’ll always give you at least four business days’ notice of a planned interruption.
